step1_analysis.circuit_type: Dynamic logic gate with multiple-input bulk boost circuit
step1_analysis.description: A dynamic logic gate where the evaluation transistor's bulk terminal is dynamically boosted by multiple inputs via MOS capacitors. This lowers the threshold voltage during evaluation, increasing the switching speed. Node N3 appears intended as an inverter output but lacks a pull-down path in the extracted netlist, so it is held high by XM1.

paper_reference.title: Design and Application of CMOS Bulk Input Scheme

delay_unboosted.description: Evaluation delay of the dynamic node without bulk boost applied.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay = C * V / I. C_N1 ~ 80fF. I_dsat for 5u/1u equivalent nfet ~ 1.28mA. Delay = 80fF * 0.9V / 1.28mA = 56ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the large W/L (5u/0.5u) of the evaluation transistors and the estimated parasitic capacitance on the dynamic node.

delay_boosted.description: Evaluation delay of the dynamic node with bulk boost applied.

sky130_expected.calculation: Boosted bulk lowers Vth by ~0.1V, increasing I_dsat by ~15%. Delay = 56ps / 1.15 = 48ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The bulk boost effect increases the drive current of the evaluation transistor, reducing the discharge time compared to the unboosted case.

vbulk_max.description: Maximum voltage reached at the boosted bulk node (N0).

sky130_expected.calculation: Coupled charge from 3 MOS caps raises N0 until clamped by the diode-connected nfet XM10 (Vth ~ 0.42V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The diode XM10 prevents the bulk voltage from rising too high and heavily forward-biasing the bulk-source junction.

avg_power.description: Average power consumption of the circuit during operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = C * V^2 * f. At 250MHz testbench frequency, P = 80fF * 1.8^2 * 250MHz = 65uW. Plus short-circuit and leakage power.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Power is lower than reported in the paper because the testbench runs at a lower frequency (250 MHz vs 1-2 GHz) and lower supply voltage (1.8V vs 2.5V).

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the evaluation delay with and without bulk boost, the maximum bulk boost voltage, and average power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Bulk Input Boost Circuit
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u

XM1 N3 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 GND LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 LABEL_NET_2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 N1 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 GND VDD GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N2 LABEL_NET_3 GND N0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N1 N3 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 N0 GND N0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N0 LABEL_NET_4 N0 N0 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N0 LABEL_NET_5 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N0 LABEL_NET_6 N0 N0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
V_L0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0
V_L1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0
V_L3 LABEL_NET_3 0 1.8

* CLK: Precharge (0) and Evaluate (1.8)
V_CLK LABEL_NET_2 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 50p 50p 2n 4n)

* Boost inputs: Active during second cycle
V_BOOST4 LABEL_NET_4 0 PULSE(0 1.8 4.9n 50p 50p 2n 8n)
V_BOOST5 LABEL_NET_5 0 PULSE(0 1.8 4.9n 50p 50p 2n 8n)
V_BOOST6 LABEL_NET_6 0 PULSE(0 1.8 4.9n 50p 50p 2n 8n)

.control
tran 10p 8n
meas tran delay_unboosted trig v(LABEL_NET_2) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran delay_boosted trig v(LABEL_NET_2) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(N1) val=0.9 fall=2
meas tran vbulk_max max v(N0) from=4.9n to=7n
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
meas tran avg_power avg power from=0 to=8n
print delay_unboosted delay_boosted vbulk_max avg_power
quit
.endc
